review: Communications dispatch orchestration and provider release gates

remediatedFindings.finding: Release-check failures could reject the shared scheduled-services Promise and delay unrelated services.
remediatedFindings.resolution: Release and candidate-discovery failures now return neutral fail-closed summaries without provider invocation.

verifiedControls: Environment and database live-send gates plus kill switch and provider credential are required.
The scheduled runtime supplies no provider adapter and therefore cannot invoke live delivery.
Discovery is bounded to 25 due WhatsApp items and excludes provider-unknown ambiguity.
Provider-template component mapping remains intentionally unattached pending an authoritative contract.
productionImpact: NONE: no deployment, migration, provider adapter, live message, credential change or production pointer change.
